data.notes: Carlos Turcios reports that promotional material for the Sept. 10 Dallas convention protest displayed the Young Active Labor Leaders Dallas-Fort Worth logo among other organization logos. This supports a promotional-material association only; it does not independently establish formal coalition membership, endorsement of other groups, or attendance at the march.
